The orchestrator reviews at every phase close and dispatches targeted fix nodes. End state: everything pushed, a new intent-factory version carrying the spec improvements, and a recorded retrospective feeding the next campaign.

Workers: glm-5.3[1m] (glm driver, Z.ai), deepseek-v4-flash (codex custom provider), gemini-3.7-flash with --effort (agy driver). Judges: gpt-5.6-sol at medium effort. Plan review: gpt-5.6-sol at xhigh. Flash workers are instantiated per phase so same-phase nodes share continuation and cache.
At every phase close the orchestrator runs the full suite and reviews the diff itself; defects go back to flash workers as targeted fix nodes, not to the orchestrator.
Repository policy: skill files, specs and script output in English (public repo); conversation with the user in pt-BR. Conventional Commits, one logical change per commit, never --no-verify.

Chain: codex emits turn.completed once per invocation, so SessionMetricsParser reports turns=1 and rotationTrigger fires at completion (weighted cache-read 478310 >= 120000 per turn over 1 turn); enforceAutomaticWorkerRotation called terminateProcess on the exiting codex, which exited with code 1; normalizeCodexResult classifies any non-zero exit as provider_error even with a completed turn and a final message; finalizeClosedJobs then took the rotation-handoff path; in the same tick enforceTokenBudget saw the node at 556k weighted over its 450k allocation, granted the 100k extension, planned continuation segment 2 and budget-killed the one-turn rotation handoff; the fresh continuation attempt called clearWorkerResultFile and destroyed the durable result. Segment 2 is re-verifying already finished work. Fix scope (glm lane, after phase 0.5 closes): rotation never triggers on an invocation whose stream already carries turn.completed; a completed turn with a final message or a valid canonical result file is done regardless of exit code; bounded rotation-handoff and result-materialization invocations are never budget-terminated; a fresh attempt adopts an existing valid canonical result instead of clearing it. The item-level codex error items (rollout_budget warning, missing deepseek model metadata) are benign and already ignored.
